schema_doc: Canonical paragraph-level corrections registry. Source of truth for all manual edits applied on top of the immutable FB2 source. Pipeline: fb2_remake.fb2 → parse → text_corrections.json → apply → remake_data.js / book_text.md.

version_history.v1 → v2: Major reconciliation pass after ChatGPT 5.5 + Gemini 3.1 Pro parallel audits (Apr 2026). Removed 3 spurious pending items (§13 stamina+15, §140 gold+30, §532 wound_2 — first two were misinterpretations of paragraph-arithmetic mechanics, third was already implemented in src/remake_data.js + src/game_logic.js). Corrected §166 canonical branch set. Registered ~25 new pending items across 4 categories: gold-sign data bugs, missing passive auto-effects, missing item acquisitions, conditional-choice gating, and the dynamic-target paragraph-arithmetic engine cluster.
version_history.v2 → v2.1: May 2026 sweep against current MJ_MAP and art_catalog.py state revealed that all Group 4 art-mapping recommendations from both audits were already in place: §1072 already maps to art09_sleeping_princess; art12_camp/art29_hostess/art41_mounted catalogues already match MJ_MAP; §319/§100/§558/§846/§1123 already use the recommended arts. The audits were taken before previous sessions had already cleaned up these mappings. Items recorded in resolved_no_op below as verified-and-resolved so future audits don't resurrect them.

Each is a non-blocker but should not be lost: §874 silver bracelet has no acquisition path; bronze whistle is granted under three different name strings; §1122 partial inventory loss (knives) is narrative-only. Added as pending groups 11, 12, 13.
version_history.v2.2 → v2.3: May 2026 investigation deepened group_11 (silver bracelet). FB2 search confirmed there is no auto-acquisition paragraph for 'Серебряный браслет'. The item is purchased from the peasant's shop in §340 along with 8 other items. §340 in remake_data.js has the FB2 text describing the shop but no purchase mechanism — only 3 navigation choices (leave west / south / stay). This is a symptom of a missing shop/buy-choice engine feature, not a single-paragraph fix. Group 11 reclassified as architectural; new group_14 added to track the shop-mechanic gap across the book.

The post-combat acquisition half of group_12 (7 paragraphs where the player kills a goblin and then takes the whistle from the corpse) cannot be closed without a new engine feature, because auto_items applies on first paragraph entry, before combat resolves. Registered as new group_15.
version_history.v2.4 → v2.5: May 2026 — group_13 reclassified after FB2 verification. The Gemini graph audit had read the §1122 «ножей и след простыл» line as inventory loss of knife-class items, but FB2 review shows the knives were never inventory items at all — they were an attack effect from a previous trap paragraph causing wounds. The §1122 effect is the canonical −5 STAMINA cost the canon states explicitly («вычесть 5 ВЫНОСЛИВОСТЕЙ за те раны»), so this is a Group 1.3-class missing auto-effect, not a Group 7-class inventory loss. Applied auto_items.stamina_sub=5 and moved registry entry from pending_corrections to resolved_no_op with the corrected interpretation. The lose_substring engine extension idea originally floated in group_13 is no longer needed for this paragraph (and there are no other knife-loss paragraphs in the data either).

group_14_shop_buy_choice_engine.comment: Several paragraphs across the book describe a shop-style merchant selling multiple items at named prices, but the engine has no purchase choice type. Players read the prices in the text, but the only choices on the screen are navigation. Found via the silver bracelet investigation (group_11) — §340 (peasant) is one such case with 9 items. There are likely others (Vodyanoy's tavern food/water sales in §873 use ad-hoc gold_sub but only on auto_items, not on choice-level purchase). A general shop mechanism would unify these. Architectural design needed before implementation: choice schema extension (new fields on choice: purchase=true, gold_cost=N, grants_items=['...']), engine renderChoices changes (show price in label, gate by S.gold>=cost, deduct gold and add item on click), and per-paragraph data fixes wherever shops occur.

Vodyanoy's tavern. Items: жареная рыба 1g (→§922), родниковая вода 2g (→§767). Has navigation choices but no item grant on those purchases. Less critical because the only food benefit is narrative — but adds inconsistency.

Re-render after purchase: should the engine track which items have been bought to prevent buying twice from the same shop, or just rely on gold deduction making infinite purchases self-limiting?

group_15_post_combat_item_grants.comment: Several paragraphs use a 'kill enemy, then take their item' pattern. Currently the only way to express this in data is auto_items.items, which applies on first entry — too early, because the player hasn't yet won the combat. Result: the post_combat choice button says 'Взять X и идти дальше' but X never enters inventory. Found during Group 12 (whistle) work, but the pattern is general and applies to every loot-from-corpse scenario in the book. Need new engine feature.
design_options: Option A: new auto_items_after_combat field. Engine applies it when sec.enemies && combatDone[S.section] becomes true, rather than on firstVisit. Symmetric with existing auto_items.

Option B: new acquires field on choice. choice = {target, label, acquires: ['Бронзовый свисток']}. Engine deposits items at the moment the player clicks the choice. More flexible — different post-combat choices could grant different items (e.g. 'take whistle' vs 'leave whistle').
Option C: paragraph splitting — introduce a synthetic intermediate paragraph between combat and the next location, and put auto_items on it. Heavy data refactor; not recommended.

group_16_gold_condition_gating.comment: Some paragraphs offer the player a choice that costs a specific amount of gold (e.g. §774: 'если есть 1 золотой — открыть дверь монетой', 'если есть 5 золотых — попробовать открыть большой сундук'). The engine has no way to gate a choice by gold-on-hand and no way to deduct the cost on click. Currently the buttons show regardless of gold balance, and clicking does not subtract. Resolution requires a new choice-level field gold_condition:N (button rendered only when S.gold>=N) and gold_cost:N (deduct on click — could reuse acquires' onclick wrapper). Different from group_14 (shop engine) in that this is a single conditional choice, not a full multi-item shop transaction.

Riddle 2 answer "смерть" (sum 107) verified: sec.932 narrative opens "Верно, ты угадал, смерть деньгами не подкупишь, — говорит паук". ChatGPT design proposal speculated "год" → §850, but Claude verification showed §850 is throne-tray narrative, not a riddle success. Correct answer rederived from canonical spider gift narrative at §932.
group_18_letter_sum_riddle.engine_changes:
Three new functions in src/game_logic.js:
  - applyRiddleAnswer(input, riddleConfig): normalise input (uppercase, strip non-Cyrillic), optional ё→е equivalence, compute sum, validate target against valid_targets allow-list AND GD existence, call goTo() or handleRiddleFail.
  - handleRiddleFail(riddleConfig): increment S.riddle_attempts, show shake animation + attempts counter; on max_attempts exhausted call goTo(fail_target).
  - renderRiddle(sec): replaces renderChoices for paragraphs with sec.riddle field; renders input + submit button + feedback row; optional manual-exit button when fail_target_label is set.
renderGame() modified to dispatch to renderRiddle when sec.riddle present; dead-end check bypassed for riddle paragraphs (their choices array is empty by design).
group_18_letter_sum_riddle.anti_cheat: Answer string never stored in code, data, or localStorage. Only modifier + valid_targets + fail_target + max_attempts stored. Math sum is one-way: 76 has thousands of letter-string preimages, so a player inspecting modifier:916 and valid_targets:[992] cannot recover "кладбище" algorithmically.

canonical_notes.FORCE: FB2 canon: "Прибавит вам силу и увеличит вашу СИЛУ УДАРА в бою." Persistent buff applied to player attack math for whole combat duration. Implementation: combatState.forceBuff=true, pMod += 2 in combatRound. Single cast per combat (re-click prevented).
canonical_notes.WEAKNESS: FB2 canon varies: "Сделает вашего врага неуклюжим и неповоротливым, ослабит СИЛУ его УДАРА" (general) and "уменьшите на 2 СИЛУ УДАРА любого из Гоблинов" (single target in multi-enemy fights). Engine applies -2 globally to all active enemies because per-round attack math doesn't track which single enemy was targeted; slightly more generous than canon for multi-enemy fights but matches the spirit of "ослабляет врага в этом бою".
canonical_notes.COPY: Pre-existing implementation (commit aeebe69) clones the strongest active enemy and runs auto-combat between clone and original. Unchanged by group_19.
canonical_notes.FIRE_combat: NOT IMPLEMENTED in this group. FB2 canon at §436 and §528 explicitly forbids FIRE on trees ("Пользоваться заклятием Огня на дереве неразумно — спалите все дерево"). No combat-modal FIRE button needed — pattern doesn't exist in canon.
canonical_notes.HEALING_combat: NOT IMPLEMENTED as combat-modal. HEALING is engine-global HUD #btn-heal restricted to NON-combat moments per spell definition ("В любой момент (но не во время сражения)"). Player can use HEALING between combats to restore stamina.

The PDF cites symbiont.games as a primary source — the same site that produced the confabulated 'Elgariol/Bardush/Nautilus' visual audit rejected at v2.34. The PDF also relied on a GraphViz file (Подземелья_черного_замка.gv) which is a SIMPLIFIED fan-site map omitting condition-gated edges (luck rolls, inventory checks, spell branches). PDF claims independently verified against actual data: a mix of true, false, and fabricated.

verified_claims: §106/§151/§178/§277/§315 'isolated' — TRUE that indeg==0, but the PDF mischaracterised them: these paragraphs DO NOT EXIST in the data at all (sparse-index gaps, not cut content). 46 paragraphs total have indeg==0 from §1's reachable set.
rejected_claims: 'Max index 1366, 145 missing numbers' — FALSE. Data keys are dense 1..1221, no sparse indexing. Fabricated from the gamebook genre's reputation, not this project's data.
'1233 logical nodes, 12 virtual' — FALSE. Data contains exactly 1221. Fabricated.
'BFS depth = 222' — FALSE. Actual BFS depth from §1 is 31. Off by ~7x.
'Longest path = 211 steps' — implausible given the BFS depth of 31; not independently computable (NP-hard on the cyclic graph) but the cited value is contradicted by other metrics.

'§18 hidden transition: parser misses to 23' — FALSE. §18 has both edges correctly in data: →23 (luck_type:'lucky') and →124 (luck failure). The .gv fan map omits one because it doesn't model luck-gated edges; the PDF read that as an engine bug.
'Avg branching 1.72' — actual 1.85 (excluding terminals). Minor numeric drift.
'§86 is cut content (indeg==0)' — FALSE. §86 has indeg==1.
group_24_external_topology_analysis_reje.root_cause: The PDF and its derived research reports analysed the fan-site GV map (a structural simplification that omits inventory/spell/luck-gated edges), NOT this project's actual data. When a luck-roll paragraph in the .gv has only the failure branch, the PDF interpreted the missing lucky-edge as 'parser misses hidden transition' — a category error. Combined with symbiont.games being the primary citation, this is the same confabulation pattern caught at v2.34, just expressed as topology numbers instead of invented characters.
group_24_external_topology_analysis_reje.actionable_findings: None for code. The exercise re-confirmed that 'sources of truth' must be assets/fb2_remake.fb2 + src/remake_data.js, not third-party maps.

group_28_night_retrigger_investigation_2.cluster_description: Investigation of the deferred §1128 'night re-trigger / infinite-stamina' concern raised by Claude-research (path 759→212→104→30→255→15). group_28_night_retrigger_investigation_2.priority: RESOLVED — no action (was deferred 'architectural' in group_25)
group_28_night_retrigger_investigation_2.verdict: Verified NOT a bug. The claimed path is a strict forward chain, not a cycle; no infinite-stamina farm exists.
evidence: The exact claimed path §1128→759→212→104→30→255→15→453 visits every node exactly once — no revisits (forward-only chain).
Self-reachability (true cycle) test: none of §1128/§15/§453/§759/§255/§212 can reach themselves again. Zero cycles among night/rest nodes.
§453's continuation (§376) never loops back into the night path (BFS depth 40, no hit).
§1128 inbound only from §1193; §453 inbound only from §15; §15 inbound only from §255 — single forward approaches, not loop entries.

There are 8 night-rest stamina nodes (§82 +4, §88 +4, §410 +7, §420 +4, §453 +3, §513 +3, §1128 +2, §1181 +4); NONE can return to itself. From §1128 you can later reach §410/§420/§453 but never return to §1128 — distinct nights on a forward journey, not a farm.
group_28_night_retrigger_investigation_2.why_canon_correct: §1128 (one night, +2 stamina) and the later §15→§453 (a different night, +3) are TWO DISTINCT nights on a multi-day forward journey — exactly as the gamebook narrates ('you travel for days and rest each night'). Collecting both rests once each is intended, not an exploit. A once-only night flag would WRONGLY block the second legitimate night's rest and contradict canon.
group_28_night_retrigger_investigation_2.note: 277 nodes lie on SOME cycle in the graph — this is normal for a gamebook (forks you can return to and pick the other branch) and is unrelated to night-rest. It does not create stamina farming because the rest nodes themselves are acyclic.
group_28_night_retrigger_investigation_2.lesson: Same pattern as the topology PDF: a plausible-looking 'exploit path' from the fan map was a hypothesis, not a verified bug. Graph verification against actual choice-edges refuted it. Recorded so it is not re-flagged.

result.all_are_root_orphans: True. All 54 have zero inbound from any reachable node; 0 nodes had a reachable inbound that BFS missed — the edge model is complete.
result.verdict: NOT 54 bugs. The unreachable set is dominated by paragraph-arithmetic + item-conditional entry nodes — reached only when the engine applies a conditional/arithmetic jump (the group_6 design: item-token gating instead of static edges). Spot-checks vs FB2: §146 referenced by §95 (password), §600 by §260 (Vodyanoy combat-win aftermath); §831/§968/§1114/§1131/§106 have ZERO FB2 textual references (pure arithmetic/conditional entry). group_29_reachability_audit_2026_05_28.root_subtree_gating: Fixing a root's conditional entry cascades to its subtree: §1023 gates 6 nodes [796,1023,1037,1174,1186,1198]; §1037 gates 5; §1198 gates 4; §1131 gates 3 [932,992,1131]; §610/§661/§664/§954/§992/§1045/§1186 each gate 2. group_29_reachability_audit_2026_05_28.genuine_gaps_found: None confirmed as static wiring bugs. Every spot-checked node is reached via a documented mechanic (riddle arithmetic, bird-guide -50, item/pass/star/key/candle inventory_condition, post-combat win). The bird-guide (group_5/7/8), speaking-house riddle, and arithmetic items (group_6) are all already implemented in the engine; these paragraphs are their canonical destinations, correctly NOT wired as plain choices.
group_29_reachability_audit_2026_05_28.method_note: This is the same lesson as the topology PDF and §1128: static graph 'unreachability' is a HYPOTHESIS, not a bug list. For this gamebook, ~4.4% of paragraphs are intentionally reached only by conditional/arithmetic mechanics. A static BFS cannot see those edges, so it over-reports orphans. Verified per-cluster against FB2 + the documented group_5/6/7/8 mechanics.

findings.issue: §340 peasant shop sells 6 'might be useful' trinkets; the deferred note flagged Попона/Золотая устрица as possible dead-weight gold-traps.
findings.investigation: Traced every §340 grants_items string through ALL 1221 canon paragraphs AND all data gating fields (inventory_condition/consume_on_use/acquires/auto_items), and checked exact grant==consumer string equality.
findings.result_wired: 4 of 6 are correctly wired with EXACT grant↔consumer string match and real uses: «Красивый кусочек дерева»→§774; «Фигурный ключ»→§774/§804/§1208; «Блестящий кусок металла»→§804; «Серебряный браслет»→§1090→§874 (given to the beggar-woman, who reveals a door). No name-mismatch typos found (the real bug risk).
findings.result_traps: 2 of 6 have NO consumer and appear ONLY at §340 in the whole canon: «Попона для лошади» (5g — a horse blanket, useless because the enchanted forest admits no rider, per the pregame text) and «Золотая устрица» (8g — priciest item, a shiny decoy). Canon frames the pile as things the peasant «как он считает, могут пригодиться» — i.e. deliberate speculative junk.
findings.decision: Intentional gold-traps; faithful to the 1991 book. Removing/repurposing them would be UNfaithful. No engine or data change. Item closed as verified-intentional.

findings.method: Measured per-spell opportunity surface in current data (engine getSpellId tag+label detection + spell_any + combat allowlists), and cross-checked ILLUSION's canon mentions vs wired hooks.
findings.economy: Opportunity surface — LEVITATION 28 nav + most obstacle crossings; FIRE 21 nav; FORCE 19 nav + 66/76 combats; WEAKNESS 15 nav + 65/76; SWIMMING 11 nav; COPY 5 nav + 65/76; HEALING 1 nav BUT usable anytime out of combat (+8) so effectively unlimited; ILLUSION 4 nav (§41/§350/§779/§1066), 0 combat — the clear outlier.
findings.illusion_finding: ILLUSION sparsity is GENUINE, not a missing-hook artifact. The 5 canon 'иллюзия' paragraphs without a wired ILLUSION choice are all anti-Illusion text, not cast-points: §134 (Fire-branch death — 'no one left to cast Illusion on'), §283 (the 'Illusion fails on the old men' result of the §779 cast), §481 (Woman-Vampire — immune; already combat_spells_allowed:[]), §723 (Spirit — immune; gates to §455, now fixed), §1094 (the Illusion SUCCESS already reached from §41's tagged Illusion choice). group_41_audit_2026_06_05_betting_phase_.cluster_description: Betting subsystem, Phase B2 — stake tracking + payout application (completes the betting system begun in group_40/B1). Before this, stakes were never deducted (losses were free) and almost no outcome paid out, so the gambling loop had no real consequence. B2 adds a stake state (S.bet_stake), deducts the stake at commit, and applies each outcome's winnings/losses — including stake-relative effects (keep/lose/half/win-N×). Plus the general stake-any-item picker (Yuriy's call: a reusable inventory-select primitive). KEY INSIGHT: the gambling loop is RE-ENTRANT (the player stakes and lands on the same outcome across many rounds), so stake/payout logic CANNOT live in first-visit auto_items — it runs every visit via a new applyBetting() hook. This also fixed a latent bug: §931/§941/§1109 previously paid out only on first visit.
group_41_audit_2026_06_05_betting_phase_.priority: P2 (betting consequence/economy; completes a whole subsystem).
group_41_audit_2026_06_05_betting_phase_.source: Betting-subgraph trace (group_40) + per-outcome canon payout text in fb2_remake.fb2; Node harness 37/37.
group_41_audit_2026_06_05_betting_phase_.mechanism: ENGINE (src/game_logic.js): (1) new state field S.bet_stake (initState + normalizeSave backfill). (2) applyBetting(sec) called EVERY visit from renderGame (after the first-visit auto_items block): handles sec.set_stake {kind:'gold',amount} (deduct + remember) | {kind:'item',name} (remove from bag + remember), and sec.bet_payout { stake:'lose'|'keep'|'half'|{multiply:N}, gold, items[], food[{name,stamina,count}], flask_zero } (resolve the remembered stake + add fixed winnings, then clear S.bet_stake). (3) renderStakePicker(sec) — a general stake_picker:true inventory-select widget: lists each bag item with a wager button that records an item stake, removes it, and routes to the item-dice router (stake_roll_target, default §910); the paragraph's non-roll choices render beneath. renderGame dispatch + dead-end guard extended for stake_picker. DATA: stake-commit + outcome payouts wired across 23 paragraphs.
group_41_audit_2026_06_05_betting_phase_.engine_change: S.bet_stake state; applyBetting() every-visit hook (set_stake + bet_payout); renderStakePicker() + stake_picker dispatch + dead-end guard. food winnings reuse the group_38 «(еда: +N)» format.
group_41_audit_2026_06_05_betting_phase_.stake_resolution_interpretation: Documented (tweakable per outcome): lose = forfeit (gold already deducted at commit; item already removed). keep = returned (refund gold / put item back). half = floor(stake/2) gold refunded (gold stakes only). {multiply:N} = winnings of N× the gold stake added (stake itself consumed, not separately refunded). Item stakes only ever hit lose/keep (the half/multiply outcomes are on the gold-die routers).

group_42_2026_06_05_multislot_inventory_.cluster_description: Multi-slot inventory occupancy. The bag was a flat array where every item counted as exactly one slot (occupancy = S.inventory.length). But two canonical items are explicitly bulky and occupy several slots, which the engine ignored — letting the player carry the diving suit or flying carpet for free alongside a full bag. This introduces an item-size concept so bag capacity is measured by summed footprint, not item count.
group_42_2026_06_05_multislot_inventory_.priority: P2 (inventory-economy fidelity; the suit/carpet are gating items so their bulk matters for resource decisions).
group_42_2026_06_05_multislot_inventory_.canon_basis: FB2 explicit slot text, verified by tight phrasing sweep: §1214 «костюм займет ДВА места в вашем заплечном мешке» → suit=2; §227 «он займет в вашем заплечном мешке целых ТРИ места», reinforced by §193 «освободить для него три места» and §302 «занимает три места» → carpet=3. The same sweep confirmed every OTHER bag item is one slot: §75 banana «займет ОДНО место», §457 «Четыре глаза занимают 1 место», §570/§649 arrows «каждая… одно место». So {suit:2, carpet:3} is the complete multi-slot set; default is 1.
group_42_2026_06_05_multislot_inventory_.mechanism: ENGINE-ONLY (src/game_logic.js), no data change. New: ITEM_SIZES map ({«Водолазный костюм»:2,«Ковёр-самолёт»:3}); getItemSize(name) → footprint (default 1, strips the food «(еда: +N)» suffix for robust matching); getBagUsed() → summed occupancy. Every capacity site converted from count-based to size-based: occupancy displays (HUD inv-count, modal «В МЕШКЕ n/max») use getBagUsed(); all push/can-add checks changed from `S.inventory.length < getBagSize()` to `getBagUsed() + getItemSize(item) <= getBagSize()`. Sites: showInventoryModal free-slots + fit text (now compares summed incoming size), renderInvModalCurrent count + found-item button enable (shows «Нужно N мест» for bulky items that don't fit), takeItem, auto_items.food grant, makePurchaseBtn foodOverflow/wouldOverflow, completePurchase items + grants_food, applyBetting bet_payout item-return/items/food, addItem (manual). The item name strings already exist in data (suit granted §1214 auto_items + gated §16/§391/§430/§951; carpet acquired §227, gated+consumed §592) so sizes live entirely in the code map — no data field needed.
group_42_2026_06_05_multislot_inventory_.engine_change: ITEM_SIZES + getItemSize() + getBagUsed() added next to getBagSize(); 16 capacity sites converted from S.inventory.length to getBagUsed()+getItemSize().

Old saves need no migration (occupancy is recomputed from inventory contents on every render). The suit grant at §1214 carries luck_add:1 (unchanged). Carpet self-destructs at §653 (consume path via §592) — the size logic correctly frees 3 slots when it's removed.

group_43_2026_06_05_DOCUMENTED_887_face6.type: DOCUMENTED ANOMALY — intentionally NOT corrected (decision: keep faithful to FB2).
group_43_2026_06_05_DOCUMENTED_887_face6.cluster_description: §887 (Goblin item-stake dice router) face-6 points to §734, which is not a betting outcome at all but a key/door scene. Flagged during the betting Phase B1 build (group_40) and formally rechecked 2026-06-05. The recheck confirms it is a genuine FB2 cross-reference error, but the intended target is not recoverable from available sources, so by decision the data is left faithful to the FB2 and the fix is deferred to a future deep-research cycle.
group_43_2026_06_05_DOCUMENTED_887_face6.priority: P3 (rare 1/6 path; cosmetically broken but low-impact and self-healing state-wise).

evidence.fb2_887_verbatim: «Вы в надежде смотрите на игральную кость. Что же выпало на кости? Один? — 625. Два? — 769. Три? — 958. Четыре? — 1039. Пять? — 1109. Шесть? — 734.» — the FB2 literally maps face 6 → 734.
evidence.para_734_text: «Достав ключ, вы отпираете дверь. Короткий коридор приводит к следующей двери — 671.» — a key/door scene leading deeper into the dungeon (§671); no gambling context, no bet_payout.
evidence.para_734_real_source: §734's legitimate inbound is §694 (locked Black-Castle-key door): choice «Отпереть дверь Ключом Чёрного замка» gated on inventory «Ключ Чёрного замка». That is §734's true purpose.
evidence.uniqueness: Among all 24 router faces (§793/§910/§887/§1187) this is the ONLY face pointing to a non-betting paragraph. The sibling Goblin router §1187 maps all six faces to real outcomes; §887's other five faces are all real outcomes (625 lose+debt, 769 lose-all, 958 keep+12g+4 apples, 1039 lose+1g, 1109 lose+6 bananas).
evidence.intended_target_unrecoverable: No orphaned bet_payout paragraph exists (every bet_payout is referenced by a router), so the data gives no hint of the intended face-6 target. The 1991 first edition text is not among the project's available sources.
evidence.impact: Rolling a 6 on the Goblin die during an item-stake game teleports the player out of the gambling scene into §734→§671 with nonsensical 'you unlock the door with your key' text; the wagered item is forfeit (removed at stake time) but S.bet_stake is left uncleared. The leak is harmless — S.bet_stake is overwritten at the next set_stake and no bet_payout reads it in between.

options_considered.A_keep_faithful: Leave face-6 → 734 exactly as the FB2 has it. CHOSEN (Yuriy, 2026-06-05). Preserves source fidelity; accepts the broken teleport + harmless stake-state leak on a 1/6 roll.
options_considered.B_remap_769: Remap face-6 → §769 («вы проиграли всё», bet_payout {stake:'lose'}). Keeps the player in the game and resolves the stake as a loss, consistent with §887's other faces; a documented deviation from the FB2 number. (Claude's recommendation if a fix were applied now.)
options_considered.C_remap_625: Remap face-6 → §625 (lose + owe 7 gold); cross-router precedent (§887 face-1 and §1187 face-6 both use §625) but pulls in the heavier debt path.

group_43_2026_06_05_DOCUMENTED_887_face6.decision: KEEP FAITHFUL TO FB2 (option A) per Yuriy, 2026-06-05. No data change to §887. Plan: run a future deep-research pass (web search for known fixes/errata of the 1991 edition's dice-game outcomes); if nothing authoritative is found, run an internal study to pick the best repair (current lead: option B → §769).
group_43_2026_06_05_DOCUMENTED_887_face6.no_change_made: src/remake_data.js is UNCHANGED — §887 face-6 still targets §734 as in the FB2. This entry is documentation only.

It carries no bet_payout, so the gold stake's state isn't formally cleared on that exit — but the gold is already correctly forfeit (deducted at the commit and never refunded), so this is cosmetic only (a stale S.bet_stake, overwritten next commit; no 'ставка проиграна' notification shown). Trivial optional polish: add bet_payout {stake:'lose'} to §855. NOT done here (kept this entry documentation-only); can be batched into the future betting-anomaly pass. group_43_2026_06_05_DOCUMENTED_887_face6.research_update_2026_06_12: 1991 original extracted locally (assets/book_1991_extracted.txt — decoded from assets/pdf_original_1991.pdf, the MyQuest/GameBooks 2011 re-typeset, via the constant +0x228 font-shift; whitespace is mangled, search the text space-insensitively). FINDING: the player dice-betting minigame does NOT exist in 1991 — zero «ставк»/«сыгра» occurrences; dice appear only as the failing castle-gate bluff («В кости», — отвечаете вы, но Орки даже не знают такой игры» §271/§585₁₉₉₁) and as the Goblins' own game in the cage scene (§409₁₉₉₁). The entire betting subsystem (routers §793/§887/§910/§1187 and their outcomes incl. §625/§769) is remake-era content; the §887 face-6 → §734 jump is therefore a remake-internal routing slip with NO external canon to restore. DECISION PENDING (Yuriy): (A) keep FB2-faithful as now, or (B) repair face 6 → §769 (the in-cluster lose-everything outcome) as a documented deliberate divergence. No data change made for this item in v2.82.
group_43_2026_06_05_DOCUMENTED_887_face6.final_verdict: FINAL VERDICT (Yuriy, 2026-06-12): OPTION A — keep FB2-faithful: §887 face 6 → §734 stays exactly as published in the remaster FB2 (the project's canon). Grounds: the June 2026 deep-research cycle (six reports: Gemini/ChatGPT/Claude × 2 sessions each; see audit_cycles/deep_research_june_2026/ARBITRATION.md, CASE 1) returned NOT FOUND on the original six-outcome dice list, the original face-6 target, and any published errata or community discussion of this misprint; the locally extracted 1991 original (assets/book_1991_extracted.txt) then settled the question conclusively — the player dice-betting minigame does not exist in the 1991 text at all (zero «ставк»/«сыгра» occurrences; dice appear only as the failing castle-gate bluff §271/§585₁₉₉₁ and the Goblins' own game §409₁₉₉₁), so the entire betting subsystem incl. §887 is remake-era content and there is no external canon to restore. The §769 lead-repair idea is RETIRED (kept above for the record only). CASE CLOSED — no data change was ever made for this anomaly; the dead-end guard / canon behavior at §734 remains as designed.

group_44_2026_06_05_625_sword_payment.cluster_description: §625 (betting 'you lost + owe 7 gold' outcome) missing sword-payment option. The canon lists FIVE ways to settle the debt — gold, sword, deck of cards, gold amulet, gold whistle, four bananas — but group_39 wired only five of the six, deliberately SKIPPING «своим мечом» because the basic sword is an implicit, untracked inventory item (every hero starts with «меч»; it never enters S.inventory). This adds the sword payment.
group_44_2026_06_05_625_sword_payment.priority: P3 (minor completeness; but it closes a real fidelity gap — see below).
group_44_2026_06_05_625_sword_payment.source: FB2 §625: «Вы можете отдать долг деньгами или какой-нибудь из перечисленных вещью: своим мечом, колодой карт, золотым амулетом, золотым свистком или четырьмя бананами. Если вы не можете расплатиться, 1142… Если можете… уходите — 919.» Node harness 15/15.
group_44_2026_06_05_625_sword_payment.mechanism: DATA-ONLY (src/remake_data.js). Added one choice to §625: {target:919, label:«Отдать свой меч (919)»}, ALWAYS available — no inventory_condition (the basic sword is always carried), no gold_condition, and no consume_on_use (the basic «меч» is not a tracked item, so there is nothing to remove). All six payment options lead to §919 per canon. No engine change.
group_44_2026_06_05_625_sword_payment.why_no_penalty: Deliberately NO swordless penalty or state flag. A full FB2 sweep for player-swordless / unarmed-combat language («без меча», «безоружн», «лишитесь меча», «вычеркните меч», etc.) found NOTHING for the player — the only unarmed references (§618, §715) describe ENEMIES. The 1991 book never models fighting without the basic sword, so giving it up has no mechanical consequence; inventing one would DEVIATE from canon. (The tracked weapon «Целый меч» at §553/§757, gated §135/§1003, is a SEPARATE found item and is unaffected.)
group_44_2026_06_05_625_sword_payment.fidelity_gap_closed: Before this, a player who is broke AND holds none of the four payable items had only the «can't pay → 1142» path (a forced 2-Orc flee-fight at §1142→1016). Canonically the sword is ALWAYS a valid payment, so the player should always be able to choose to pay (→919) instead of being forced to flee. §1142 now correctly represents a player CHOICE to flee rather than the only option. The sword option being always-available mirrors the canon (you always have a sword to forfeit); §1142 stays reachable as a voluntary 'rather fight than pay' choice.
group_44_2026_06_05_625_sword_payment.status_done: Closed 2026-06-05 — one data+registry commit. Node harness 15/15: sword option shape (target 919, no condition/consume), visibility for a broke item-less player (sword + flee both visible; gold-7 and item options correctly hidden; exactly 2 visible), applyChoiceConsume(sword) is a no-op (inventory unchanged), gated-options regression (gold-7/cards reappear when affordable/owned), §625 bet_payout {stake:'lose'} intact. No engine, no state, no save-format impact. §625's stake resolution (bet_payout {stake:'lose'}, group_41) is unchanged.
group_44_2026_06_05_625_sword_payment.side_note: Because the sword option is mechanically free (no tracked cost), a player could always settle the §625 debt by forfeiting the sword. This matches the FB2 exactly (the book lists the sword as an unconditional payment and never penalises swordlessness); it is faithful, not an exploit. The other payment options remain meaningful for players who role-play keeping their sword.

items.previously_claimed: Gemini visual art audit: split art31_bandit_road for §319 (negotiation) vs art35_bandits_ambush for §100 (combat).
items.reason: FB2 §319 describes the moment bandits ambush from all sides ("с разных сторон на поляну выскакивают пятеро… разбойники, ждущие в засаде"), so art35_bandits_ambush is the correct illustration for both §319 and §100. art31_bandit_road depicts an injured bandit by a roadside trap, which matches §19/§155 (where it is currently bound). No split needed.

items.previously_claimed: Gemini graph audit: §1122 narrates loss of a single named item type (knives — «ножей и следа нет»). Engine has no partial-named-loss mechanism — needs lose_substring or explicit lose list.
items.reason: FB2 verification: the «ножей» in §1122 are NOT inventory items. They are wound-effects from a previous trap paragraph. Knife-class items are nowhere granted in any auto_items.items[] across the entire data. The actual §1122 mutation per canon is «вычесть 5 ВЫНОСЛИВОСТЕЙ за те раны, которые были нанесены вам ножами» — a stamina cost, not inventory loss. Applied as auto_items.stamina_sub=5. The lose_substring engine idea is no longer needed for this paragraph.

Gemini 3.1 Pro audit flagged §36 (Trader Skill 7 / Stamina 17) and §760 (Bats Skill 4 / Stamina 6–8) as combat outliers. On review these are intentional pacing choices: the trader is a deliberate HP-sponge / mid-game choke point; the bats are a stamina-drain encounter by design. Neither is a bug. Listing as a design note in case a future balance pass revisits individual encounters, but no engine or data work is required.
items.note_2026_05_24: Verdict unchanged: the trader's Skill 7 / Stamina 17 HP-sponge stays as designed. SEPARATELY, the per-hit damage value (canon: 'не 2, а 4') was missing and was fixed in group_20 subgroup_a (commit 1301c23). The stat block and the per-hit damage are different attributes; this note prevents the damage fix being mistaken for overturning the design-note.

items.reason: Gemini 3.1 Pro audit observed that ILLUSION and HEALING spells have only 1–2 uses each across 1221 paragraphs while FIRE and LEVITATION are mandatory. The audit suggested either rebalancing the canon or warning the player at character creation. Both options are out of scope: rebalancing the canon would mean changing the source book; the character-creation warning is a UX feature that belongs in a separate pass and is not registry-tracked. Diagnostic only — no fix planned. Players read the canon and choose accordingly.
